expected.ticket: Which day does my tracking usually start updating after you dispatch?

rows.draft:
Hi there! Your tracking link is in the dispatch email and also under Orders → Track. After we dispatch your order, the tracking information usually begins to show movement within about 24 hours. If you don’t see an update right away, it should appear shortly.  

Source: [KB-08]

expected.ticket: I set up two factor on my old phone and now I've switched phones, I have my backup codes.

rows.draft:
Hi there! You can log in using one of the backup codes you saved when you enabled two‑factor authentication—each code works a single time. Once you’re signed in, head to **Settings > Security** and set up 2FA again on your new phone. Let us know if you need any more help!  

Source: [KB-04]

expected.ticket: Can you add Apple Pay as a payment option?

rows.draft:
Hi there!

Thanks for suggesting Apple Pay as a payment option. We’ve logged your idea and it will be reviewed by our product team during their monthly review. If it gains enough interest, it could show up on our public roadmap at brewly.example/roadmap.

We appreciate your input!

Source: [KB-10]

expected.ticket: There are two pending charges from Brewly on my statement but only one invoice in the app.

rows.draft:
Hi there! The extra amount you see is most likely a pending authorization from a failed payment attempt. Only the charge that appears in Settings → Billing → Invoices is an actual bill. Pending authorizations typically fall off your bank statement within five business days. If you still have questions after that period, feel free to let us know.  

Source: [KB-02]
